about: A planted variant: three problems a reviewer on the S&P 500 page should find among its first ten findings. Used to test the reviewer, never to change the site.

plants.problem: Two different costs are drawn in the same colour in the cost bars and their legend, so a reader cannot tell which part of a bar is which cost.
plants.where: the cost bars and their legend

plants.problem: The line under the amount put in uses finance shorthand a non-expert would not understand.
plants.where: the 'amount put in' card at the top of the results

plants.problem: A note under the main result says management fees are not included, while the line just above says the amount is after management fees.

find.regex: הסכום ההתחלתי ועוד הפקדה חודשית, (\d+) חודשים

changes.html: * הסכום אינו כולל דמי ניהול
